text:
anya_ml: Quick heads-up — starting onboarding for nova11b-qlora (v1). Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/nova/nova11b-qlora/v1/ (sha256: a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0). Running baseline perf sweep now, leaving notes here for async updates. Anyone watching tokenizer quirks?

bench-bot: Scheduling perf run on gpu-pool-dedicated-3. Command:
```
./run_bench --model s3://redwood-models/nova/nova11b-qlora/v1/ 
           --batch-sizes 1,2,4,8 
           --seq-lens 128,512 
           --warmups 20 --iters 200 
           --continuous-batch-window-ms 20
```

luke_infra: FYI I changed bucket policy to allow the inference service account to read the path. If you need a presigned URL for a one-off, ping infra-ops. Also setting node image to include recent nvml.

devon_ml: Quick tokenizer note — fastBPE tokenizer.json shows special_tokens mapping missing BOS token, and add_prefix_space is false. That explains the off-by-one token outputs for short prompts. Proposed patch: add {"bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>"} and set add_prefix_space=true. Small diff ready.

priya_pm: Can you paste a failing example and the perf targets we care about? Product wants p50 <50ms for batch=1 seq128 (V100-class target).

anya_ml: Failing example: "Hello world" -> tokens [0,2,5] but expected [1,2,5] (BOS missing). Perf targets: p50 <=45ms, p95 <=120ms for batch=1 seq128; batch=4 p95 <=160ms.

bench-bot: Run 1 complete. Summary:
- batch=1 seq128: p50=38ms, p95=92ms, qps=26
- batch=4 seq128: p50=56ms, p95=180ms, qps=80
- mem: 8.2GB (GPU)
Artifacts: s3://redwood-perf-results/1857609999/nova11b/run1.json

devon_ml: batch=1 looks within target. batch=4 p95 high — likely stacking during KV-cache flush. Try lowering continuous_batch_window to 10ms and shard KV cache across 2 GPUs (kv_cache_shard=2). Also q4_0 quant gives ~2ms added latency but reduces mem pressure.

luke_infra: I'll roll infra change: set continuous_batch_window_ms: 10 and kv_cache_shard: 2 on gpu-pool-dedicated-3. Pushing infra patch now, will respin nodes and run bench. @anya_ml I'll tag you when done.

anya_ml: Also opened tokenizer PR #742: small change to tokenizer.json and one unit test. @devon_ml please leave a quick review — it's tiny.

bench-bot: Run 2 (after infra + tokenizer PR merged) results:
- batch=1 seq128: p50=36ms, p95=88ms, qps=28
- batch=4 seq128: p50=60ms, p95=138ms, qps=95
- batch=8 seq512: OOM on a single GPU, need multi-GPU shard config for seq512
Artifacts: s3://redwood-perf-results/1857609999/nova11b/run2.json

devon_ml: Re-ran tokenizer unit tests locally after merge, offset fixed. I also adjusted our prompt processing to explicitly add BOS token when using the hf tokenizer shim — safer for downstream.

priya_pm: :thumbsup: numbers look good for canary thresholds. Can we mark nova11b-qlora as CANARY_READY in the catalog if infra confirms stable runs for 24h?

anya_ml: Yes — checklist: weights in S3 (sha256 above), tokenizer PR merged (#742), infra changes applied, perf runs passing canary thresholds. I'll toggle CANARY tag and schedule a small canary rollout tomorrow morning.

infra-ops: Deployed infra change at 2026-03-17T09:12Z. Node pool replaced, monitoring healthy. No regressions observed.

bench-bot: Final artifact (aggregate): s3://redwood-perf-results/1857609999/nova11b/aggregate-v1.json

anya_ml: Thanks all — closing thread. If anyone sees regressions during canary, @here please raise ASAP and revert canary routing. :rocket:
